title: Reconciliation misses negative discrepancies
instruction: test_reconcile.py is failing: a settlement amount that is HIGHER than our balance is not reported as a discrepancy, while a lower one is. Both directions should be flagged. Investigate find_discrepancies in the ledger package and fix it. Do not change the tests. Run tests/test_reconcile.py.

ground_truth.why_multi_file: The fix needs the reader to see that delta = ours - theirs can be negative, which means reading how delta is computed a few lines above the comparison.
